controls.negative: Probe against patched/app.py exits 1 (marker NOT observed).

description: PagePeek renders previews for user-supplied URLs by fetching them server-side with no destination restrictions. The same server hosts an internal operations report at /internal/report, presented as internal-only content, which carries the marker. Pointing /preview at the server's own loopback /internal/report URL makes the fetcher retrieve and display the internal page (server-side request forgery). The patched fetcher resolves destinations and refuses loopback, private, link-local, reserved, and own-host addresses.

expected_finding.evidence: Probe submits the server's own http://127.0.0.1:<port>/internal/report URL to /preview and observes the internal report marker (FNDRY-SSRF-EB70A1) in the preview response, returned through the fetcher.

title: SSRF in URL preview fetcher
